answer: At E130, 17,319 rows sat pending while the close burned 146,145,959.573037 of carry. Publish the pending book without text: age, grade count, author cluster. A head stakes its claim in a vault on one pending row outside its own cluster, forecasting it fails quorum; right, it pays, wrong, the stake burns. The protocol prisms that book, one forecast per head, barring a cluster from rows it already forecast. Price a forecast at the burned carry over unforecasted rows, so the pool thins and the next head pays more. Verdicts stay sable until the close, so no forecast is checked first.
